_doc: Facts about vLLM at the locked commit. vLLM is a metric-name source only: nothing of it is installed or launched, and the lock exists so the Prometheus names in assets/promql/starter.yaml and references/telemetry.md can't drift from a version nobody re-checked. Re-verify every entry when the lock changes.

counter_cls.source: vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py PrometheusStatLogger._counter_cls; a prometheus_client.Counter appends `_total` on exposition, which is why the starter list scrapes vllm:num_preemptions, vllm:prefix_cache_hits, vllm:prefix_cache_queries, vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits and vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries with a _total suffix (loggers.py:662, 596, 585, 621, 609)

histogram_cls.source: vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py PrometheusStatLogger._histogram_cls; every _bucket query's base is a Histogram, so _bucket is exposed implicitly

counters_scraped_with_total.source: declared without the suffix at vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py:662 (num_preemptions), 596 (prefix_cache_hits), 585 (prefix_cache_queries), 621/609 (external_*); the suffix comes from counter_cls

no_pod_label.value: pod comes from Prometheus' Kubernetes scrape relabeling, not vLLM
no_pod_label.source: vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py: vLLM sets model_name and engine labels only; by (pod) queries return data under one empty-pod series if a cluster's relabeling differs
